dialogues.speaker: Wangjuan
dialogues.text: We who live near the lower Yilong Wharf are bombarded by the sound of the waterfall every day, so our hearing tends to not be that sharp.

dialogues.speaker: Wangjuan
dialogues.text: Stay safe while checking out the waterfall, you hear?

dialogues.speaker: Wangjuan
dialogues.text: The huge difference in height and the violent waters can crush even the most sturdy battleships, let alone an ordinary human.

dialogues.speaker: Wangjuan
dialogues.text: Well, not that you feel ordinary in the slightest, but best not to take the risk anyway.
